governance_state_reuse_correction.diagnosis: The harness reused frozen S1-S3 model outputs but redundantly re-imported identical evidence, re-proposed identical conclusions, re-invoked the batch judge, and rebuilt identical admissions in every cell. This violated the frozen one-sender-state-per-model-task design and multiplied local and judge proof-price.
governance_state_reuse_correction.correction: Clone the frozen sender ledger, proposals, and policy receipts for every clean cell. For a stress cell, clone the same base governance state and process only the newly injected stress artifact and conclusion. Preserve append-only per-item events and all source receipts.
governance_state_reuse_correction.cost_accounting: Charge sender generation and base transaction-level judge once per model/task. Charge each cell only for incremental stress review, context assembly, receiver work, and evaluation. Aggregation must de-duplicate reused request IDs.
